source_conflicts_and_limits.locator: Main Figure 3f; Supplementary Figure 1m–o, PDF page 13
source_conflicts_and_limits.observation: Biomagnetic fitted IRM fractions: 78.2% at 45 cm background; 75.7% at 225 cm labelled enriched; 76.4% at 525 cm background. Fraction is not selectively higher in enriched sample. Absolute magnetic intensities and operational phase inventories are different quantities.
source_conflicts_and_limits.handling: Explicit in record; do not equate a fitted magnetic component with microbial biomass or REY fraction.

source_conflicts_and_limits.locator: Main Discussion page 8, Figure 5; Supplementary Table 3 page 7
source_conflicts_and_limits.observation: Isotope mixing (0–2% endmember contribution) and multiplicative estimate (17.6% of REY enrichment) have different denominators. The latter uses 22.3% operational extracted iron, 25.3% after excluding the weakly crystalline pool, 75.7% fitted IRM signal and >92% modeled retention. Initial poorly crystalline inventory and signal-to-mass conversion are not measured in this study.
source_conflicts_and_limits.handling: Retain hypothesis; neither measured microbial fraction nor independently verified minimum claim imported.

source_conflicts_and_limits.locator: Main Results page 2; Supplementary Table 1 pages 3–5; Data.xlsx Major and trace elements B4:B53
source_conflicts_and_limits.observation: Narrative Fe2O3 range 6.94–8.72 wt.% differs from tabulated/workbook range 6.08–9.42 wt.%.

source_conflicts_and_limits.locator: Main Results page 2; Supplementary Table 2 page 6; Data.xlsx Iron isotopes B3:B27
source_conflicts_and_limits.observation: Narrative minimum δ56Fe −0.08 per mille differs from minimum −0.07 in the inspected table/workbook; header says 56Fe/54Fe (per mille), while methods define delta relative to IRMM-14.
source_conflicts_and_limits.handling: No exact isotope observation imported or silently relabelled.

source_conflicts_and_limits.locator: Main Discussion page 8; Supplementary Table 6 page 11
source_conflicts_and_limits.observation: Main depositional interval 11.8–13 Ma versus supplemental GC112 age 13.0–11.5 Ma; chronology is correlated from GC18.
source_conflicts_and_limits.handling: Exact age and causal climate linkage withheld; record retains conflict.

source_conflicts_and_limits.locator: Supplementary Figure 1 page 13 versus Results and Supplementary Table 3
source_conflicts_and_limits.observation: Detailed enriched magnetic sample is 225 cm, whereas the main central interval and iron-fraction cohort are described as 240–390 cm. Figure 2 uses a separate >700 mg/kg threshold, which also includes some background-labelled samples.
source_conflicts_and_limits.handling: Retain exact sample labels; do not imply all magnetic and sequential-extraction measurements are paired aliquots from one horizon.

source_conflicts_and_limits.locator: Data.xlsx κ-T A2 and Figure 3a / Supplementary Figure 1a–c
source_conflicts_and_limits.observation: Workbook labels temperature K; published κ-T axes are degrees Celsius and data start near 28.8. ZFC/FC genuinely use K and are distinct tests.
source_conflicts_and_limits.handling: No unit conversion or native time/temperature series imported.

source_conflicts_and_limits.locator: Zenodo metadata description versus publisher supplementary tables
source_conflicts_and_limits.observation: Zenodo list S5/S6 are ZFC/FC and κ-T, S7 fish teeth; final publisher S5 fish teeth, S6 age compilation, S7 extraction reagents. Workbook has Sr, while final S1 has TOC and analytical standards.
source_conflicts_and_limits.handling: Join by actual sheet/column and study, not table number. Same dataset/paper family, not independent evidence.
